title: Finger Lickin' Doom
summary: I got carried away talking about KFC's Doomsday promotion that I made a mashup track
content:
For the latest episode of Ruminate I tried the Doom burger at KFC. We spoke at length about the greenness of it all on the episode, which I think it's worth your time, especially if you're new to the show. When I was prepping for the show I had an idea to mashup the Avengers theme song with the Beastie Boys track, Finger Lickin' Good.

I've never done a mashup before but I was able to change the tempo of the Avengers theme to match closer to the Beastie Boys track, as well as extracted the vocals using lalal.ai and make something I quite like. I even did a cover for it because why not — finding a photo of the Colonel with two other friends was harder than expected. The font I used is Fresh Marker which is pretty close to the original.
